column3: “It will be captured” is rendered as past, “has been captured.”
“Will go up” is rendered as past, “has come up.”
“The direction hither” is rendered “turning their faces in its direction.”
The written text has “shepherds … mountains, they led them astray”; NASB follows the reading tradition, “turn aside on the mountains.”
“Take flight” is rendered “Wander away”; “before the flock” becomes “at the head of.”
“Heifer threshing” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “calves in the grass.”
“Last of nations” is rendered “the least of the nations.”
“Not it will remain” is rendered “she will not be inhabited.”
“Given her hand” is rendered “given herself up,” and “towers” as “pillars.”
“Restore” is rendered “bring … back,” and NASB supplies “his desire.”
“Merathaim” (double rebellion) and “Pekod” (punishment) are kept as names.
“Engaged in strife” is rendered “engaged in conflict.”
“From the end” is rendered “from the farthest border.”
“Archers” is rendered “many,” following a slightly different reading.
